title: Oracle Evening Brief
script_summary:
**BITCOIN EVENING BRIEF**

Bitcoin closed US hours at $60,060—up 2.3% and holding above the key $60K support level. Daily range hit $58,900 to $61,200, giving us a 2,300-point spread.

Here's what matters: We're trading in extreme fear at 19 on the Greed Index, yet price is climbing. That's classic capitulation bottom behavior. The hashrate sits rock-solid at 954 exahashes—miners aren't panicking, they're committed.

Transaction backlog is lean at 105K mempool transactions with base fees just 3
